highlights_headline: 3.119.5 is an in-progress 3.x servicing release fixing WinUI Projection loading and adding Apple 26.0 TFM backports.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: Fixes an issue where the WinUI Projection DLL could not be located when consumed from a .NET 9 application.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Backports the 4.x-line Apple TFM alignment (versioned 26.0 libraries, unversioned app TFMs) to the 3.x servicing branch.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM changes to 3.x
